binding.fresh_evidence: needs a licensed run of the privileged scope-alignment workflow on the head under review
binding.historical_once: the PLE-S model, the evaluator, the governed scope, the scope validator, the shared-asset superset, the catalogue or the configurator move after that revision
binding.rule: verified against the files of the commit that last changed this directory along first parents (git log -1 --first-parent -- docs/product-line-engineering/ple-s-scope-alignment-evidence), extracted from Git history by tests/test_ple_scope_alignment_oracle.py; never against the working tree

comparison.note: comparison.json carries the digests of the catalogue, the configurator, the shared-asset superset, the correspondence and the oracle script it was produced with; its oracle.executor_revision is the commit it was produced at (informational)

elements_export.note: 1.1 MB serialized element export; not retained, digest recorded by the receipt

tree_identical_to.note: the run executed this main commit (maintainer dispatch with it as ref), not a pull-request head; the executor and the merge are the same commit
